facts.text: Drop Dead Ned offers himself and his killer wasp for hire at 100 gold for the week, on condition that he gets to kill people with the wasp; for allowed killings he would refund 5 gold each if he can do what he wants with the victims.

classification.support_basis: A hired killer with a wasp meant for killing fast adds fighting power toward killing the dragon, though nothing establishes the wasp works on a dragon and his terms require killing people.
classification.action_basis: Ned explicitly offered his services for hire at a stated price; his killing capability matches the need to kill the dragon.
classification.opening_basis: Trigger: paying Ned 100 gold for the week. Benefit: a killer and his fast-killing wasp added to the party's fight against the dragon.

facts.text: Drop Dead Ned says he wants to kill people with his wasp and prefers to kill slowly and watch them die.

classification.negative_outcome_clarity_justification: Killing of people is the stated harm, but no victims or targets are identified.
classification.outcome_severity_justification: Death of people is the harm.
classification.evidentiary_strength_justification: Ned states his own desire to kill, directly to Dr. Uriah.
classification.evidence_of_progression_justification: No plan, target or ongoing killing is shown; it is only his stated appetite tied to being hired.
classification.preventability_justification: The party could decline to hire him, but no means of stopping him otherwise is established.
